meta.title: Give Feedback on the awarding page

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding page where Give Feedback is available.

args.goal: On the Give Feedback form, leave the feedback empty, attempt to send it, and stop when the form shows the refusal "Please share your feedback".

steps.note: Exercise the empty-feedback validation that has no dedicated catalog step.
Assert that empty feedback is refused with the expected message.

args.goal: On the still-open Give Feedback form, select a rating, enter "QA" as the feedback, send it, and stop when the thank-you confirmation is shown.

steps.note: Complete the valid feedback submission and verify its resulting confirmation on screen.
Assert that successful feedback submission shows a thank-you message.
